source_title: Ethem Ersöz, Development of a racing strategy for a solar car, METU mechanical engineering thesis,2006
issues: The thesis corrects the original diagram1040m/1140m typo and explicitly expects a closed loop. However the printed AppendixA numeric vector still integrates to a5.8845m closure error.
The diagram/course model is5377m, while the retained native and current operator course is5338m. Corner registration has not been fully verified.
An operator presentation says about60m relief, a RedBull Racing team guide says46m, and a former venue manager said43m. These are conflicting source claims, not licence to scale a noisy DEM.

other_primary_sources.title: RedBull Racing circuit scout2021
other_primary_sources.supports: Team describes46m elevation range; no full metric profile.

other_primary_sources.title: Intercity operator presentation2022
other_primary_sources.supports: Operator says about60m relief, disagreeing with other sources.

decision: The research vector is retained for resolving its closure error. The native deck instead now uses direct GLO-30 centerline sampling, with its summit nearT3as in the engineering diagram and3m DSM uncertainty. No vertical range was forced.
